# Repetition means unheard

`customer_support.heu.de_escalation.repetition_means_unheard` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> If the customer repeats themselves, stop advancing — they have not been heard yet.


## The heuristic

**If the customer repeats themselves, stop advancing — they have not been heard yet.**


_Why:_ Repetition is not emphasis and it is not stubbornness; it is the reliable signal that our last message did not land. Continuing to push the resolution forward from that point makes every subsequent message land the same way.
